items.title: West Kowloon station: ticket check, security, Hong Kong exit and China entry
items.note: The morning before this (check out, breakfast, the West Kowloon promenade) is in the main Hong Kong plan. Be inside the station by about 10:15 am, 60–90 min before the train. Show the passport with the China visa; the e-ticket is linked to it. The real-name check closes 30 min before departure and the gates 5 min before. Luggage rule on these trains: 20 kg per adult in total, each piece no more than 130 cm (length + width + height); how strictly it is checked is not confirmed.

items.costBasis: CNY 45-70 a person for noodles plus a skewer or side (Baidu average CNY 92 includes lamb dishes and set meals)
items.costSource: https://map.baidu.com/?newmap=1&qt=inf&uid=b37298247870808dabf0cd09 (Baidu Maps 4.4, average CNY 92); https://au.trip.com/restaurant/china/shanghai/detail/GGJ%20Muslim%20Restaurant-11151821 (Trip.com 4.8 from 68 reviews; a review of 5 Nov 2026 suggests a bowl of noodles for one)

visas.title: Tourist (L) visa, single entry, VIP service
visas.summary: Needed to enter mainland China at Hong Kong West Kowloon station on 24 Dec. One entry and one exit (back to Hong Kong on 3 Jan), so a single-entry visa is enough. Egypt is not on China's visa-free or 240-hour transit lists. We are taking the VIP service to skip the queue. Apply in person in Cairo; both of you should go.
facts: 4,560 EGP (about US$84): visa fee 400 EGP (reduced until 31 Dec 2026) + Regular service fee 2,080 EGP + VIP service 2,080 EGP to skip the queue.
About 4 working days for Regular; the centre works Sunday to Thursday. Ask whether VIP is also faster. Fingerprints are waived until 31 Dec 2026 and no appointment is needed.
Online form by Sun 22 Nov, hand in 22–26 Nov (recommended). Latest safe date: Thu 3 Dec.
Chinese Visa Application Service Center, Dokki, Cairo. Hand in 9 am – 12 pm, collect 1 pm – 4 pm. Phone 02 3748 3425.
Usually 3 months to enter; you need a stay of 11 days (24 Dec – 3 Jan).
Fill in China's free online arrival card (NIA website, 12367 app, WeChat or Alipay) before 24 Dec.
documents: Passport valid at least 6 months (keep both valid to July 2027 to be safe), with two consecutive blank pages and no damage
Online application form, printed approval certificate
Round-trip flight booking record (the centre advises buying tickets after the visa is issued)
Hotel reservations in Shanghai (24–31 Dec) and Guangzhou (31 Dec – 3 Jan): the Booking.com pay-at-the-property bookings, addresses and dates matching the form)
Recent bank statement in English with the holder's name and currency; for the partner's account, an English marriage certificate
steps: Create an account on the Cairo visa centre website and fill in the online form; upload the documents
Wait for the online review; fix and resubmit if it shows Rejected
When it shows Approved, print the certificate
Go to the centre with the certificate, passports and photos, and pay
Collect the passports about 4 working days later
